rules.name: no_claim_above_dependency_status
rules.statement: A claim may not exceed the weakest required theorem, lemma, proof, gap, or simulation dependency.

rules.name: no_supported_claim_with_open_gap
rules.statement: A claim depending on an open or contested gap may not be labeled supported unless scoped as conditional.

rules.name: no_operator_signature_mismatch
rules.statement: An operator may not be used in a proof, claim, or simulation binding with inputs or outputs outside its registered signature.

rules.name: no_publication_language_above_status
rules.statement: Publication rhetoric must not exceed theorem status, claim class, evidence level, or rhetorical scope.

rules.name: no_simulation_support_without_certified_binding
rules.statement: A simulation may not support a claim unless its tool certification, simulation-proof binding, and recoverable provenance satisfy the claim class.
